title: Islamabad SWAT Force Receives 20 New Vehicles
excerpt: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi provided 20 new vehicles to the Islamabad Police Special Weapons and Tactics Force.
body_html: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi officially provided twenty new vehicles to the Islamabad Police Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) Force. The addition aims to enhance the operational capabilities of the specialized law enforcement unit in the capital.
